intro: Between April and May 2026, ZCyberNews published nine articles on persistence, with Comburglar, VENOMOUS#HELPER, and VoidLink emerging as the top threat actors. The coverage highlighted vulnerabilities including CVE-2023-30253, CVE-2024-48760, and CVE-2025-6793, affecting sectors such as government, enterprise, financial services, multiple, and technology. The threat was assessed as high severity, with a global impact and specific focus on the United States.
